title: Smoother Flow Matching via Contrastive Trajectory Repulsion
abstract: arXiv:2610.01408v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Trajectory crossing remains a critical bottleneck in Flow Matching (FM), and previous works typically view these crossings from a theoretical optimization perspective causing velocity averaging. They attempt to address it indirectly by post-hoc distillation or endpoint coupling, without explicitly regulating the intermediate trajectories. In this paper, we introduce a new network learning perspective: crossing points inherently induce large local Lipschitz constants in the target velocity field, leading to two drawbacks. First, high Lipschitz constants correspond to high-frequency signals in the velocity field that neural networks struggle to fit due to spectral bias. Second, they also imply drastic velocity variations, leading to severe numerical integration errors in few-step inference. To alleviate this, we propose CoFlow, a framework that introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into FM to explicitly repel trajectories during t

translated_title: 通过对比轨迹排斥实现更平滑的流匹配
translated_abstract: 轨迹交叉仍然是流匹配中的一个关键瓶颈，以往的工作通常从理论优化的角度看待这些交叉，认为其导致了速度平均化，并试图通过事后蒸馏或端点耦合来间接解决这一问题，而没有显式地调控中间轨迹。在本文中，我们引入了一个新的网络学习视角：交叉点会在目标速度场中固有地引起较大的局部Lipschitz常数，从而导致两个缺点。首先，高Lipschitz常数对应于速度场中的高频信号，而由于频谱偏差，神经网络难以拟合这些信号。其次，它们还意味着剧烈的速度变化，导致少步推理中出现严重的数值积分误差。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出了CoFlow，这是一个将对比学习范式引入流匹配的框架，在训练过程中显式地排斥轨迹……
tldr: 提出CoFlow框架，首次将对比学习引入流匹配，通过显式排斥中间轨迹来降低目标速度场的局部Lipschitz常数，从而缓解轨迹交叉带来的高频拟合困难与少步推理的数值积分误差。
en_tdlr: CoFlow introduces the contrastive learning paradigm into Flow Matching to explicitly repel intermediate trajectories, lowering local Lipschitz constants in the velocity field and thereby alleviating trajectory crossing, high-frequency fitting difficulties, and numerical integration errors in few-step inference.
